purpose: Phase 4.2 closeout section A - the repair-rate denominator and its classification criteria are pinned HERE, before the closeout CLASSIFICATION run, so the denominator cannot be re-derived after the numerator is known. A closeout run must classify using these criteria by id; it may not invent a class or re-argue one.

rules.ambiguousRationale: The conservative direction: it ENLARGES the denominator and makes the 70% target harder, so an honest mistake cannot inflate the rate.
rules.zeroDenominator: 0/0 is UNDEFINED, not 100%. Report 'NO PIPELINE-DRIVEN FAILURES REMAIN' separately from any ratio.
rules.productFidelityMapping: PRODUCT_FIDELITY failures map to SOURCE_DRIVEN unless a distinct criterion is registered here. None is registered.
rules.postRunReDerivation: FORBIDDEN. If a criterion is found to be wrong, amend this registry in its own commit, state why, and re-run the entire evidence set.

criteria.name: compression-component confidence defect
criteria.test: Addressable source; confidence gate rejected it; the limiting component is `segmentation` and the pre-repair penalty was driven by raw connected-component count rather than significant-component count.

criteria.name: incorrect confidence aggregation
criteria.test: Addressable source; every stage gate passed; the internal confidence score alone rejected it.

criteria.name: preprocessing defect
criteria.test: Addressable source; failure traced to decode, normalization, padding handling, or crop handling performed by this pipeline.

criteria.name: anchor derivation defect
criteria.test: Addressable source; segmentation produced a usable mask; ANCHORS_INCOMPLETE or an anchor-limited confidence miss followed.

criteria.name: incorrect fidelity rejection
criteria.test: Addressable source; fidelity rejected it AND a registered distinct criterion establishes the fidelity logic itself was wrong. NOT satisfied by a fidelity failure alone — see rules.productFidelityMapping.

criteria.name: model-worn
criteria.test: Shot class HARD via skin-tone presence; Phase 4 has no model-worn extraction path by design.

criteria.name: missing garment region
criteria.test: No reliable garment region found (GARMENT_NOT_PRIMARY from segmentation failure).

criteria.name: thumbnail inadequate
criteria.test: SOURCE_TOO_SMALL, or source adequacy INADEQUATE with resolution as the measured limiter.

criteria.name: unsupported visual source
criteria.test: Shot class UNSUPPORTED, or MULTIPLE_GARMENTS / CROP_INCOMPLETE — properties of the photograph, not of the implementation.

criteria.name: product fidelity
criteria.test: PRODUCT_FIDELITY_FAILED or PATTERN_UNRECOVERABLE without a registered PD-5 criterion.

criteria.name: variant ambiguity
criteria.test: VARIANT_AMBIGUOUS, or an alternate-image substitution refused on variant-safety grounds.

criteria.name: unsupported category
criteria.test: UNSUPPORTED_CATEGORY — no Live template family maps to this product's canonical category.

criteria.name: insufficient Commerce image surface
criteria.test: The product exposes no addressable image candidate because the Commerce contract carries only one image per product. Measured 490/490 on this feed.

historicalDenominator.corpus: Phase 4.1 Gate E real cohort, N=220
historicalDenominator.identityBasis: source sha256; product refs are run-local and URLs were never committed

cases.note: Confidence-gate miss on an addressable source; Phase 4.1 could not name the limiting component at all.
No PD-5 criterion is registered, so fidelity maps to SOURCE_DRIVEN per rules.productFidelityMapping.

historicalDenominator.smallNCaveat: Denominator is 4, far below the §B floor of 20. A repair rate computed over 4 cases cannot alone support ENGINEERING PASS; the verdict then rests on the qualitative items (four EASY dispositions, previously-eligible check, explainability).

extractionUnreliableBreakdown.corpus: Phase 4.1 Gate E real cohort, N=220
extractionUnreliableBreakdown.interpretation: 27 of 29 were HARD sources refused at the EXTRACTION STAGE (non-uniform background, no model-worn path) — segmentation never ran, which is why their source adequacy is UNKNOWN. Those are SOURCE_DRIVEN by criterion SD-1/SD-2. Only 2 of 29 were confidence-gate misses on addressable sources (PD-2). The bucket was never predominantly a pipeline problem.

p42001PriorPenalty.preRepairSegmentationScore: exactly 0.0 for all 21, because (n-1)*0.05 saturates at n>=21
p42001PriorPenalty.postRepairSegmentationScore: fillRatio * (1 - (significant-1)*0.05); for the 17 cases with significant==1 the penalty term is 1.0, so the score becomes fillRatio unmodified
p42001PriorPenalty.conversionToEligibility: NOT MEASURED — requires running extraction, anchors, geometry and QA against the source pixels, which requires the corpus cache.

pinningProvenance.correction: An earlier wording claimed this registry was pinned 'before any run'. That is false for the 490-product CATALOG CHARACTERIZATION run, committed in 6a2d298 at 2026-09-05 13:57:19 -0400, while this registry was committed in 69237a2 at 15:37:24 -0400 - 1h40m LATER.
pinningProvenance.whatIsActuallyPreRegistered: These criteria precede the closeout CLASSIFICATION run (6230e77, 15:46:20) and the verdict that followed. They do NOT precede the characterization run, nor the Phase 4.1 Gate E 220-run whose four failures they classify.
pinningProvenance.consequence: Criterion PD-1 is written in terms of a defect (raw-vs-significant component count) that P42-001 had already diagnosed and repaired before this file existed. It is therefore a RETROSPECTIVE description of a known outcome, not a blind pre-registration, and cannot carry the anti-gaming weight a true pre-registration would.
pinningProvenance.whyThisIsNotAnInflatedResult: No repair-rate success was claimed. The closeout reports the numerator as NOT MEASURED (provider quota) and states the denominator of 4 is far below the registered minimum-N floor of 20. The defect is the provenance CLAIM, not a headline number.
pinningProvenance.immutabilityAfterThisPoint: No commit after 69237a2 modifies any criterion. This block is additive provenance and changes no criterion, class, or rule.
